divergences: CGNAT: ssrf_guard._ip_is_blocked additionally blocks RFC 6598 100.64.0.0/10 (IPv4Address only), applied verbatim from open/unmerged PR #630 (head ff070bd5e9dadeaa5da32ccffd868b15eb642aa9, which changes src/alienclaw/tools/_ssrf_guard.py a67f6c7d -> 328ac5f8). In-tree allows these addresses. This is the only decision difference at equivalent configuration; tests/test_parity_in_tree.py asserts it explicitly and fails if in-tree starts blocking CGNAT.
test_url_fetch_ssrf_cgnat.py derives from PR #630 head ff070bd5; the file is absent at source_commit, so its source_blob is taken from that PR commit, not from source_commit.
boundary: removed the OpenClaw/env helpers workspace_root(), file_write_root(), _openclaw_home() and the _OPENCLAW_SUBPATH constant; callers always pass the boundary root explicitly.

boundary: the hardcoded ~/.openclaw denial inside assert_inside_boundary became a keyword-only parameter deny_roots=() (iterable of str/PathLike; a single str/PathLike is accepted). Default denies nothing beyond the boundary. With deny_roots=[Path.home() / '.openclaw'] every decision is identical to in-tree (asserted by tests/test_parity_in_tree.py).

boundary: deny-root rejection message changed from 'OpenClaw workspace denied: "<path>" targets an OpenClaw agent directory' to 'Denied root: "<path>" targets a denied directory'. All other error messages in both modules are byte-identical to in-tree.
Docstrings/comments genericised (product names, ticket numbers and caller file references removed).

2026-11-26: three security fixes were applied to BOTH sides (in-tree src/alienclaw/tools and this package) with identical code, so they are not divergences: (1) dotfile rule: the final component that names something is checked ('.env/', '.env/./' were accepted because basename() was ''), and so is the resolved path's final component (symlink to a dotfile); dot-directories stay allowed; (2) checked host vs connected host: the guard refuses backslash/whitespace/control characters, userinfo, '%' in the host, a second ':' outside brackets, host characters outside [a-z0-9._-] after IDNA, and any URL whose urllib/http.client (host, port) differs from the checked one, and it now RETURNS A CANONICAL URL (lower-case scheme/host, IDNA host, port only if given, no userinfo) instead of the input; covers security-review SR-01 (backslash with requests) and SR-03 (multi-colon port split, %2f/%23); (3) assert_no_symlink gained keyword-only operation='write' (message wording only) so read paths can use it; in-tree file_read now calls it on the unresolved path and opens with O_NOFOLLOW (file_read has no staged counterpart). The ssrf_guard/boundary source_blob values above are the FIXED in-tree blobs (uncommitted when written, so absent at source_commit); the CGNAT divergence is unchanged.

2026-11-26: tests/test_file_boundary.py and tests/test_http_get_ssrf.py had their strict xfails (trailing-slash dotfile; connect host) converted into passing regression tests; the in-tree tests they were adapted from are unchanged. tests/test_connect_host.py additionally checks the returned URL against urllib3, httpx and yarl (each skipped if not installed); that part has no in-tree counterpart. tests/test_parity_in_tree.py's corpus gained the new URL and path vectors.

Ported tests are guard-level only: tool-level assertions (RunResult ok/correctness, atomic write, output contract, compute/extract_json/search_text guards in test_file_boundary.py) were not ported. The real-socket HTTPServer redirect tests were replaced with an in-process urllib handler, and DNS is a fake resolver (real libc parser via AI_NUMERICHOST for literals), so the suite is network-free.

connection pinning added (staged only, 2026-11-26): new src/agent_tool_sandbox/pinning.py (resolve_and_validate -> PinnedTarget, build_pinned_opener, pinned_urlopen, PinnedHTTPConnection/PinnedHTTPSConnection: dial only the validated IPs, no second resolution, Host/SNI/cert check on the original host, no redirects, no proxies) and tests/test_pinning.py; __init__.py re-exports the four public names. In ssrf_guard.py the body of assert_safe_fetch_url moved into private _validate_fetch_url, which also returns scheme/host/effective port and the ONE resolution's addresses; assert_safe_fetch_url returns its canonical_url. Decisions and messages are unchanged (parity corpus unchanged and green). In-tree src/alienclaw/tools has no pinning.
